data.gender_notes: Julio is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Julio is derived from the Latin name Julius, which is believed to have been derived from the Roman god Jupiter, the god of the sky and thunder. In Christian tradition, the name Julio can be associated with St. Julian of Le Mans, a 4th-century Roman soldier who converted to Christianity and became a bishop. St. Julian is known for his bravery and his dedication to his faith, despite facing persecution for his beliefs. Therefore, the name Julio can symbolize courage and faith.
